info.name: Get historical rates for an underlying token

params.name: address
params.description: Underlying token contract address (e.g. DAI, USDC, USDT, WETH on Ethereum).

params.name: start
params.description: Unix timestamp to filter results from (inclusive).

params.name: end
params.description: Unix timestamp to filter results to (inclusive).

params.name: isRisk
params.description: Filter by strategy risk type. true returns risk-adjusted strategy data, false returns the default Best Yield strategy data.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Number of seconds between data records. Defaults to 86400 (one day).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

items.docs: Provides historical daily APY/rate data for Best Yield vaults filtered by the underlying token address and an optional calendar range.
